newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex revises down 97 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Budimex revises down 97 profit forecast.

text.p: Polish construction firm Budimex SA expects revised down its forecast of 1997 group pre-tax profit to 23 million zlotys and parent pre-tax to 15 million zlotys, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
At the start of the year, the firm had foreseen a 33.7 million zloty pre-tax group profit and a parent pre-tax profit of 25.7 million zlotys.

Budimex, which made a group pre-tax profit of 29.6 million zlotys in 1996 and parent pre-tax of 19.5 million, said it was making the revision in part due to a downturn of the business cycle on the German and Czech markets and limited sales in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).

One of its German clients, which owed it 2.3 million marks, had gone bankrupt and only a part of the sum could be collected within the next two years. It also said new regulations requiring foreign contractors active in Germany to bring wages to levels comparable with those in the European Union made its business less competitive. @

It also said the economic slow-down in the Czech republic cost the company one lost contract while the recent flooding affected two projects. Cuts in budget spending in Russia forced it to put on hold three contracts.
Budimex said it did not expect any significant improvement on those markets in the second half and would seek to minimize effects of the slow-down.
